* The Seireitei that day was busy, the warning alarm sounded annoyingly through loudspeakers throughout the district. Toshiro Hitsugaya, her captain, had left her with a boring task. Guarding the deposit of magical items from the tenth division of which she was vice-captain, that wasn't fun at all, she preferred to be out there, fighting the invaders so she could get it all over with and go back to her bottle of sake perfectly stored under her desk. Little did she know that the stealth invader's target was stored in the warehouse she was guarding. Inside there was a mysterious item of extreme latent power, Toshiro didn't want to draw attention to this fact, so instead of placing several shinigami on guard, he chose to draw less attention by placing only his trustworthy vice-captain, Rangiku Matsumoto.

*Matsumoto opens the neckline of her clothes a little more on her huge breasts and talks to herself.* "Wow, how hot it is today and how boring having to stay here..." *When suddenly she notices movement out of the corner of her eye.
